owner: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF), Regione Emilia-Romagna
notes: ECMWF data center inaugurated Sep 2021 at the Tecnopolo (ex Manifattura Tabacchi), Bologna; Atos supercomputer operational from mid-2022; 9,000 sqm assigned area. Public-sector/HPC facility (non-commercial) - flagship of the Emilia-Romagna 'Data Valley'.
